readout_other: FFMQ; NADA-T; NADA-S (daily); MAIA-2; daily free-response phenomenological reports with thematic analysis
direction_notes: Pre-post increases in trait mindfulness, nondual awareness and body listening; qualitative reports of greater equanimity, concentration and sensory clarity on stimulation days. No sham control, so effects cannot be attributed to tFUS.
safety_notes: Sensation survey after each session (median 1, not present); one light-headed episode (not attributed to tFUS), transient apprehension, headaches or scalp tingling reported in some instances.

exposures.label: tFUS to the PCC during a ten-day retreat

timing.protocol_description: 500 kHz, 1000 Hz PRF, 5 ms pulses, 5% duty cycle; during each 10-minute session the device alternated 5 s on and 10 s off. Two sessions on nonconsecutive days, three or four days apart.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Eligible participants (n = 29) received two 10-minute tFUS stimulation sessions during the 10-day retreat.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Eligible participants (n = 29) received two 10-minute tFUS stimulation sessions during the 10-day retreat.
